variants.headline: Home world sends punitive expedition
variants.sub: A punitive expedition has been dispatched by the home world.
variants.body:
The home world has sent a punitive expedition. Dispatch and arrival are different events, and this report establishes only the former. Readers considering {target} should not be asked to accept an invented landing, confrontation or account of force as part of the news of its departure.

Ordinary people should remain visible in arguments about distant power. Labour's concern is the right to live and work without being treated as scenery for somebody else's assertion of authority. That concern is strong enough without claims about casualties, damage or disruption that have not been established.

The conduct of {target} warrants scrutiny in relation to the dispatch. This newspaper does not treat the expedition's purpose as evidence of an unreported encounter or an established outcome in the colony. Ordinary lives should be the measure, not a convenient afterthought.
